actual_parent_no_schema_delta.why: The migration probe compares the parent's own sqlite_master objects with the upgraded tree's, table by table and index/trigger by index/trigger, on the same database the parent wrote; every inherited fact is compared byte-for-byte and any ask is checked not to add the lazy practice_timers row.

advisory_channel.deterministic: same stored state + same question -> same answer
advisory_channel.calendar_surface: answers unavailable on every day: no fetch, no cache, and "I could not look" is never turned into "no high-impact news"

scope: M109 the advisory channel: a deterministic, read-only question channel over findings the app already computed (coach insights, the guardrail/cap state, the trader own records). No model, no key, no network call, no new data, no prediction, no permission, no override, no transcript; refusals are successful answers and unknown stays unknown. It is required in exactly one file (its route), it writes nothing at all (a full battery leaves every table byte-identical and does not create M108 lazy practice_timers row), it adds no schema object and no backup key, and it cannot permit, block, size, grade or change anything. M64/M106/M107/M108 stay separate mechanisms. M30/M103 partial; M110/M111/M112 TODO. No70%/causal/predictive/profiler/broker/provider/human/mental-state/pixel/production proof, and no predictor of any kind.
